########################################
#
# Script contains analysis to compute retention of reads throughout the different
# LongAIRR processing steps determined by the summary.tsv generated during
# LongAIRR processing for each dataset.
#
# We compare additional Bulk samples supporting Fig. 2e and comparing to a different
# experimental protocol (S5_ONT_Q17_UDI06, S6_ONT_Q17_UDI20, S7_ONT_Q17_UDI12, S8_ONT_Q17_UDI13)
#
# Results are shown in LongAIRR Fig. S1
#
########################################

```{r}
read_bulk_run <- function(file) {
    read_delim(file, delim = "\t", skip = 2, col_types = cols(.default = col_character()), trim_ws = TRUE) %>%
    transmute(
      Step_raw     = str_remove(str_squish(Step), "^>"),
      PathInfo     = str_squish(PathInfo),
      InputReads   = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(InputReads)),
      OutputReads  = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(OutputReads)),
      OutputDescription = str_squish(OutputDescription),
      Step = case_when(
        Step_raw == "InputRate" ~ "Total_in",
        Step_raw == "Filtering" ~ "Filter_out",
        Step_raw == "Demux"     ~ "Demux_out",
        Step_raw == "Collapse"  ~ "Group_sets",
        Step_raw == "Seqtag"    ~ "Seqtag_out",
        Step_raw == "AIRR"      ~ "AIRR_out",
        Step_raw == "AIRRRate"  ~ "AIRR_prod",
        TRUE ~ Step_raw),
      summary_tsv = file) %>%
    filter(Step %in% steps_levels)
}

```


helper to build one row per udi
```{r}
build_one_udi_row <- function(run_df, run_file, samplename, udi, steps_levels) {
  demux <- run_df %>%
   filter(Step == "Demux_out", PathInfo == udi) %>%
   dplyr::slice(1)

  seqtag <- run_df %>%
    filter(Step == "Seqtag_out", PathInfo == udi) %>%
    dplyr::slice(1)

  airr_out <- run_df %>%
    filter(Step == "AIRR_out", PathInfo == paste0(udi, " | Ig"),
      OutputDescription == "Sequences with valid V(D)J annotation") %>%
    dplyr::slice(1)

  airr_prod <- run_df %>%
    filter(Step == "AIRR_prod", PathInfo == paste0(udi, " | Ig")) %>%
    dplyr::slice(1)

  consensus <- run_df %>%
    filter(Step == "Group_sets", PathInfo == paste0(udi, " | Consensus")) %>%
    dplyr::slice(1)

  bind_rows(demux, consensus, seqtag, airr_out, airr_prod) %>%
    transmute(
      summary_tsv = run_file,
      sample = samplename,
      udi = udi,
      Step = factor(Step, levels = steps_levels),
      OutputReads = OutputReads)
}
```

build rows per bulk run
```{r}
build_rows_for_one_run <- function(run_df, run_file, sample_map) {
  # add TOTAL_IN if missing from Filter_out InputReads
  trunk_base <- run_df %>%
    filter(Step == "Filter_out") %>%
    dplyr::slice(1)

  total_in_val <- run_df %>%
    filter(Step == "Total_in") %>%
    dplyr::slice(1) %>%
    pull(OutputReads)

  if (length(total_in_val) == 0 || is.na(total_in_val[1])) {
    total_in_val <- trunk_base %>% pull(InputReads)
  }

  filter_out_val <- trunk_base %>% pull(OutputReads)

  # shared lines
  trunk <- tibble(
    summary_tsv = run_file,
    Step = c("Total_in", "Filter_out"),
    OutputReads = c(total_in_val[1], filter_out_val[1])) %>%
    mutate(Step = factor(Step, levels = steps_levels))

  # per-udi lines
  post <- purrr::pmap_dfr(list(sample_map$sample, sample_map$udi),
    ~ build_one_udi_row(run_df = run_df, run_file = run_file, samplename = ..1, udi = ..2, steps_levels = steps_levels))

  list(trunk = trunk, post = post)
}
```

#------------use functions

```{r}
runs <- samples %>% distinct(summary_tsv)

run_objs <- map(runs$summary_tsv, function(run_file) {
  run_df <- read_bulk_run(run_file)
  sample_map <- samples %>% filter(summary_tsv == run_file) %>% select(sample, udi)
  build_rows_for_one_run(run_df, run_file, sample_map)
})

#shared
df_trunk_all <- bind_rows(map(run_objs, "trunk")) %>%
  mutate(run_col = unname(run_cols[summary_tsv]))
# post-demux
df_post_all <- bind_rows(map(run_objs, "post")) %>%
  mutate(sample = factor(sample, levels = sample_list))
```

data wrangling to connect lines
```{r}
df_trunk_expanded <- samples %>%
  select(sample, summary_tsv) %>%
  left_join(df_trunk_all %>% select(summary_tsv, Step, OutputReads), by = "summary_tsv") %>%
  mutate(sample = factor(sample, levels = sample_list),
    Step   = factor(Step, levels = steps_levels))

df_connected <- bind_rows(
  df_trunk_expanded %>% mutate(layer = "connected"),
  df_post_all %>% mutate(layer = "connected")) %>%
  mutate(Step = factor(as.character(Step), levels = steps_levels)) %>%
  arrange(sample, Step)
```

retention curves figure

```{r}
bulk_retention <- ggplot() +

  geom_line(data = df_connected, aes(x = Step, y = OutputReads, group = sample, color = sample), linewidth = 1.15) + # sample lines (connect across trunk + post)
```

build number table
```{r}
extract_outputs_bulk <- function(sample_name) {
  df_one <- df_post_all %>% filter(sample == sample_name)

  run_file <- samples %>%
    filter(sample == sample_name) %>%
    pull(summary_tsv) %>%
    .[1]

  total_in <- df_trunk_all %>%
    filter(summary_tsv == run_file, Step == "Total_in") %>%
    pull(OutputReads) %>%
    .[1]

  filter_out <- df_trunk_all %>%
    filter(summary_tsv == run_file, Step == "Filter_out") %>%
    pull(OutputReads) %>%
    .[1]

  c(Total_in   = total_in,
    Filter_out = filter_out,
    Demux_out  = df_one$OutputReads[df_one$Step == "Demux_out"][1],
    Group_sets = df_one$OutputReads[df_one$Step == "Group_sets"][1],
    Seqtag_out = df_one$OutputReads[df_one$Step == "Seqtag_out"][1],
    AIRR_out   = df_one$OutputReads[df_one$Step == "AIRR_out"][1],
    AIRR_prod  = df_one$OutputReads[df_one$Step == "AIRR_prod"][1])
}
```

```{r}
table_numeric <- samples %>%
  mutate(values = map(sample, extract_outputs_bulk)) %>%
  unnest_wider(values) %>%
  mutate(Sample_display = sample)

# collapse shared columns within each run
cols_to_collapse <- c("Total_in", "Filter_out")

table_display <- table_numeric %>%
  group_by(summary_tsv) %>%
  arrange(sample, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(cols_to_collapse),
           ~ if_else(row_number() > 1, "\"", as.character(.x)))) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(across(-c(sample, summary_tsv, udi, col, Sample_display),
           ~ if_else(is.na(.x), "/", as.character(.x))))

tbl_df <- table_display %>%
  mutate(row_id        = row_number(),
    Sample_factor = factor(row_id, levels = rev(row_id)),
    row_parity    = if_else(row_id %% 2 == 1, "odd", "even"),
    group_color   = unname(sample_cols[as.character(sample)]))

labels_named <- setNames(
  sprintf("<span style='color:%s; font-weight:bold'>%s</span>", tbl_df$group_color, tbl_df$Sample_display), tbl_df$Sample_factor)

tbl_long <- tbl_df %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Total_in, Filter_out, Demux_out, Group_sets, Seqtag_out, AIRR_out, AIRR_prod),
    names_to  = "Step",
    values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(Step = factor(Step, levels = c("Total_in","Filter_out","Demux_out","Group_sets","Seqtag_out","AIRR_out","AIRR_prod")))
```

table figure
```{r}
table_plot <- ggplot(tbl_long, aes(x = Step, y = Sample_factor)) +
  geom_tile(aes(fill = row_parity), width = 0.95, height = 0.95, color = NA) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(odd = "#F5F5F5", even = "#E0E0E0"), guide = "none") +
  geom_text(aes(label = value), size = 2.5, color = "black") +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = labels_named, name = NULL) +
```
